intro: Trying to find Washington scholarships that consider financial need without wading into the highest award tiers? This filtered USA view narrows the search to programs with listed awards under the upper cap shown in the filter, so you can compare more realistic options side by side. The rows below span areas such as education, community, STEM, medicine, disability, and other miscellaneous topics, with examples that touch education, nonprofit ties, agriculture, engineering, and health-related study. Requirements are not identical across listings: some may ask for more materials, some appear lighter-touch, and essay expectations can differ. Deadlines also vary by program, so it makes sense to check timing early if you plan to apply in this cycle.
